ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/off-white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions occupy the central portion of both lobes. High-contrast black pigmentation defines the leading and trailing edges. Discrete dark-pixel linear streaks and focal clusters are distributed across the white substrate.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-depth angle of 50 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially obscured by high-luminance water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (serrations) along the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve along the leading edge, tapering to narrow terminal tips on both lateral ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered low-density clusters of small circular dark focal points, particularly concentrated near the trailing edges and terminal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the white pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-directional linear rake marks and an irregular, possibly traumatic jaggedness along the medial trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the fluke-to-peduncle attachment point and the median notch base by high-intensity turbulent water spray.
